label: M1 Polygon: us 的缝合偏移 -0.002 抄成 -0.02
M2 Polygon: 第 0 个角该拿 uu1 却拿 uu0
from: this.vertices[0] = v0.remap(f(f(uu1! / texW) - us), f(f(vv0! / texH) + vs));
to: this.vertices[0] = v0.remap(f(f(uu0 / texW) - us), f(f(vv0! / texH) + vs));

label: M3 Polygon: 第 1 个角的 +vs 写成 -vs
from: this.vertices[1] = v1!.remap(f(f(uu0 / texW) + us), f(f(vv0! / texH) + vs));
to: this.vertices[1] = v1!.remap(f(f(uu0 / texW) + us), f(f(vv0 / texH) - vs));

label: M4 Polygon: vs 用 texW 除（该用 texH）
M5 Polygon: 第 2 个角该拿 vv1 却拿 vv0
from: this.vertices[2] = v2!.remap(f(f(uu0 / texW) + us), f(f(vv1! / texH) - vs));
to: this.vertices[2] = v2!.remap(f(f(uu0 / texW) + us), f(f(vv0 / texH) - vs));

label: M6 Polygon: 法线用 v0.cross(v1)（顺序反了）
M7 Polygon: render 忘了乘 scale
from: t.vertexUV(f(v.pos.x * scale), f(v.pos.y * scale), f(v.pos.z * scale), v.u, v.v);

label: M8 Polygon: mirror 循环跑满 4 次（等于没换）
M9 Polygon: 4 参构造不拷贝、直接存引用
from: this.vertices[0] = new VertexPT(v0.pos.x, v0.pos.y, v0.pos.z, v0.u, v0.v);

label: M10 Vertex: remap 改成就地改自己
to: this.u = u; this.v = v; return this;
